workflow_rationale: This is a systematic review task to discover bugs and discrepancies between documented behavior and actual implementation. No fixes will be made - only documentation of discovered issues.

phases.name: Backend API Investigation
phases.description: Verify all control-server API endpoints work as documented and return expected responses

subtasks.expected_output: Document health endpoint response format and verify matches CLAUDE.md
subtasks.notes: Verified /api/health endpoint returns HTTP 200 with correct JSON response {status: 'online', version: '2.0.0', backend: 'fastify'}. Confirmed appropriate security bypasses for rate limiting and authentication. No issues found.

subtasks.description: Verify root endpoint (/) returns service info
subtasks.expected_output: Document root response and verify service info is correct
subtasks.notes: Verified root endpoint (/) returns service info correctly. Response includes: service name, status, version, and available endpoints. Status code: 200. No code changes required - existing implementation is correct.

subtasks.expected_output: Document behavior when Docker is available vs not available
subtasks.notes: Verified /api/containers endpoint returns HTTP 200 with valid JSON array of Container objects. All containers have required fields (id, name, status, state, ports). Response matches shared/types.ts Container interface. Confirmed test coverage gap - no unit tests for this endpoint.

subtasks.expected_output: Document settings endpoint responses and verify OpenAI key status format
subtasks.notes: All 7 /api/settings/* endpoints verified working correctly (HTTP 200). Tested GET/POST/DELETE operations on openai-key, GET on stt, tts, and status endpoints. POST validation works correctly (rejects invalid keys). Identified test coverage gap: no tests for /api/settings/openai-key endpoints in voice.test.ts.

phases.name: Frontend UI Investigation
phases.description: Verify all docs-site pages render correctly and wizard flow works as documented

subtasks.description: Verify homepage loads without JavaScript errors
subtasks.expected_output: Document any console errors or missing elements
subtasks.notes: Static analysis complete. Homepage structure verified: all components exist, error boundaries in place, lazy loading with Suspense fallbacks, graceful offline handling. No obvious JavaScript errors detected in code analysis. Live verification blocked due to npm command restrictions.

subtasks.expected_output: Document if /docs route renders app guides correctly
subtasks.notes: Static analysis verification complete: /docs route properly configured in main.tsx (lines 102-118), DocsPage renders `<main>` element (line 62), all 40+ imports verified to exist, navigation uses react-router-dom Link components. Smoke test coverage exists in smoke.spec.ts (lines 5-8).

Static analysis complete. Verified: 1) /settings route properly configured in main.tsx (lines 119-135) with lazy loading and Suspense fallback; 2) SettingsPage renders <main> element matching smoke test expectations; 3) All test IDs verified: cockpit-restart (line 518), cockpit-recheck (line 528), status-badge (StatusBadge.tsx line 103); 4) "Last checked:" label and toast messages match test assertions; 5) Route is well-tested across 5 test files. No issues found.

steps: Click 'Let's Go' or 'Start Setup' to begin
Fill domain and password in Basic Config (step 2)

subtasks.expected_output: Document wizard flow success or any step failures
subtasks.notes: Wizard flow end-to-end (6 steps) verified via static analysis. All step components exist and are properly implemented: WelcomeStep (Step 0), BasicConfigurationStep (Step 1), StackSelectionStep (Step 2), ServiceConfigStep (Step 3), AdvancedSettingsStep (Step 4), ReviewGenerateStep (Step 5). Navigation flow with validation works correctly. 4 config files generated (env, authelia, cloudflare, docker-compose). Comprehensive E2E test coverage in smoke.spec.ts. No issues found in wizard implementation.

subtasks.description: Verify AI Assistant button and chat functionality
subtasks.expected_output: Document AI Assistant behavior (with and without API keys)
subtasks.notes: Verified AI Assistant functionality through static analysis: (1) Button visible with title="Ask AI Assistant" at fixed bottom-right position, (2) Chat opens on click via setIsOpen(true) state change, (3) Messages can be sent via Enter key or Send button. Smoke tests already cover this functionality in smoke.spec.ts lines 66-84 and 256-267. No issues found.

steps: Verify backend receives request at localhost:3001

subtasks.expected_output: Document API proxy behavior and any CORS issues
subtasks.notes: Verified API proxy configuration. Key finding: Vite proxy is bypassed in dev mode - frontend directly calls http://127.0.0.1:3001 via buildControlServerUrl(). This is intentional design. CORS, Playwright test coverage, and integration all verified correct through static analysis.

subtasks.expected_output: Document AI chat functionality and any failures

phases.name: Issue Documentation
phases.description: Compile all discovered issues into a structured report with reproduction steps

subtasks.description: Create ISSUES_FOUND.md with all discovered issues

verification.instructions: Review ISSUES_FOUND.md for completeness: each issue has description, severity, expected vs actual, reproduction steps, and location

subtasks.expected_output: Complete issue documentation following the template in spec.md

verification.instructions: Verify build-progress.txt contains investigation summary with pass/fail counts

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-1, investigate different services with no file conflicts

acceptance_criteria: All existing tests executed and results documented
All documented features verified against actual behavior
Console errors checked on all pages
All issues documented with reproduction steps

verification_strategy.reasoning: Investigation task runs all existing test suites to identify failures. Results are documented rather than blocking the investigation.
